units.rawText: My first encounter with Professor... Well, that's not something I'd rather think about, but I have to express my thanks again, Professor.

spans.text: My first encounter with Professor... Well, that's not something I'd rather think about, but I have to express my thanks again, Professor.

units.rawText: Without your help, Professor, I wouldn't have been saved, and others, including De Lacey, would have been caught by the same desperation that encompassed me then.

units.rawText: The Entropy suppressor we developed with the Oasis, along with the Entropic code we shared... I was saved because of them, and was later able to rescue Lind thanks to them as well.

units.rawText: I haven't spent much time alone with you, Professor. But I... well, we've all received your care and support. Um... how should I say this... T-Thank you.

spans.text: I haven't spent much time alone with you, Professor. But I... well, we've all received your care and support. Um... how should I say this... T-Thank you.

units.rawText: Sueyoi, I can't take all the credit. Rescuing you was a team effort, and we could never have prepared the Entropy suppressor for mass production in time without the Guardians' support.

units.rawText: If you insist... Fine, I'll accept your gratitude.

units.rawText: From here, our teams will follow the Oasis into the battlefield. Though we are Guardians, our beliefs align closely with the Exiles'. I'm looking forward to working alongside you, Professor.

units.rawText: Then watch me closely—I'll prove to you just how much I'm worth.
